value.configuration_html:
Configuration:

  • 7 cards per box.

Look for 6 premium cards and 1 Base card per box on average.

Cards To Chase: Autographs or memorabilia cards of Babe Ruth, Lou Gehrig, Mickey Mantle, Ted Williams, Roberto Clemente, Satchel Paige, Jimmie Foxx, and others across sets like The Spectacular Card Autograph and Memorabilia Booklet cards, Signature Tag Teams cards, Museum Cuts Booklet cards, Spectacular Spikes cards, Spirit of '76 Signatures and Memorbailia cards, and additional hits, inserts, variations, and parallels.
value.description_html:
After a grand slam debut in 2025, Leaf Spectacular Baseball is back for 2026 and taking the product to another level!

Look for an impressive lineup of legendary game-used memorabilia celebrating baseball's rich history. Spectacular Spikes makes its debut with large pieces from the bottom of game-used baseball cleats. These distinctive memorabilia cards bring collectors one step closer to pieces of baseball history. In honor of America's birthday, look for Spirit of '76 Signatures and Memorabilia featuring baseball stars and memorabilia connected to the historic 1976 season. This patriotic addition brings stars and stripes to the 2026 Spectacular Baseball lineup.

New for 2026, Signature Tag Team combines autographs with tags from game-used jerseys for a dynamic memorabilia experience. Collectors can also look for exciting multi-sign memorabilia cards featuring some of baseball's biggest names. Another exciting addition for 2026 is Spectacular Card booklet cards. Just as the name suggests, these booklets are designed to be Spectacular! Look for astonishing beautiful booklet cards featuring either 12 memorabilia pieces or 12 signatures! Also new for 2026, look for Museum Cuts Booklet cards.

Look for two or three multi-sign cards and at least one booklet card in every case! Find memorabilia cards throughout the product from baseball legends like Babe Ruth, Lou Gehrig, Mickey Mantle, Ted Williams, Roberto Clemente, Satchel Paige, Jimmie Foxx, and many more!

post.description: Browse a department instead of searching: 'all 2025 baseball boxes and cases, cheapest first'. Take the category slug from a site URL or the categories sitemap; take filter keys and option codes from a previous page's `filters`.

category.description: Category slug from /c/{category} (baseball-cards, basketball-cards, football-cards, hockey-cards, gaming-cards, non-sport-cards, other-sports-cards, autographs, supplies, ...), optionally with a /{subcategory} segment. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*(/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)?$.

filters.description: Filter key -> option code(s), as the page's `filters` reports them (year: '2025', configuration: ['box','case'], availability: 'in_stock', game: 'pokemon', price: '50-150'). Multiple codes for one key are OR-ed. Values must be strings or arrays of strings.

page.description:
Result page, 1-based. Use `next_page` from the previous output to continue.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 1.

sort.description:
Sort order (the site's keys). Omitted: the site's default order.

Provider reference: allowed values ["new", "newly-added", "price-low", "price-high", "sale-ending", "sale-new", "title-az", "title-za"].

url.description: A pasted www.steelcitycollectibles.com/c/... URL; its filter, sort and page parameters are used. Mutually exclusive with `category`.
